The '''Armored Heavyweight AZ Leg System''' was a bipedal locomotion unit for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] built by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It was made of [[Manganese/Legends|manganese]] [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]] and high-[[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] [[Steel/Legends|steel]].
